'''The Clenched Fist of Hate''' was a [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] [[The Force/Legends|Force]] user and an unwilling follower of [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]].

==History==
Before becoming an unwilling follower of Exar Kun, the Clenched Fist of Hate was a student at [[Corellia University/Legends|Corellia University]], and may have been a member of an archeological expedition on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] that unknowingly tunneled into the tombs below the [[Temple of Exar Kun]] and released the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord's]] spirit. The evil spirit bound the students and researchers to his will, and inducted them into the [[Cult of Exar Kun]]. Afterward, he sent them to [[Talus/Legends|Talus]], to the [[Corellia University research outpost]] they had originally come from to [[Slavery/Legends|enslave]] the rest of the people there. The majority of them were then sent back to Yavin 4.

After losing contact with the outpost and fearing the worst, [[Cornelius Wagglehorn|Professor Cornelius Wagglehorn]] hired a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] to travel to Talus and investigate. After arriving at the research outpost and discovering what had happened, the spacers informed the professor. He sent them the location of the tomb and implored them to travel there and destroy the malevolent spirit.

The Clenched Fist was the fourth major enemy the group encountered, having previously encountered and defeated the [[Open Hand of Hate]], the [[Minder of Weak Wills]], and the [[Caretaker of the Lost Souls]]. The Clenched Fist would prove to be their biggest challenge yet. After sending six of his tomb guardian minions after the spacers, two at a time, the Clenched Fist launched his attack at the group, brandishing a long, two-handed [[Sword/Legends|sword]] of [[Massassi/Legends|Massassi]] construction, and constantly setting many of the spacers ablaze with the Force. After a long battle, with many burns and blade cuts suffered by the ragtag group of spacers, the Clenched Fist was finally [[Death/Legends|killed]], his spirit fleeing from the grasp of [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]]. After his death, the spacers were free to challenge Exar Kun's spirit directly.

==Behind the scenes==
The Clenched Fist of Hate was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:EK" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Clenched Fist of Hate was added to the game as part of the [[W:c:swg:Exar Kun|"Exar Kun" Heroic Encounter]],<ref name="SWG:EK" /> introduced with the release of the [[W:c:swg:Chapter 9 Notes for April 3 2008|"Chapter 9" update]], on [[April 3]], [[2008]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 9: The Fury of Exar Kun">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67688&month=042008|text=Chapter 9: The Fury of Exar Kun}}</ref>

The Clenched Fist of Hate was a "boss" enemy NPC in the Temple of Exar Kun Heroic Encounter. He was the fourth encounter in the instance, coming after the Open Hand of Hate, the Minder of Weak Wills and the Caretaker of Lost Souls.
